rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for biting and holding onto something tough repeatedly.

example.english: The dog refuses to let go as it continues to gnaw on the bone.
example.traditional: 隻狗咬住條骨，點都唔肯放。
example.jyutping: zek3 gau2 ngaau5 zyu6 tiu4 gwat1 dim2 dou1 m4 hang2 fong3

rows.note: Use this when a thought, comment, or problem keeps causing someone deep worry.

example.english: This problem has continued to gnaw at me all week, and I still think about it when I sleep.
example.traditional: 呢個問題困擾咗我成個星期，我瞓覺都仲諗住。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 kwan3 jiu2 zo2 ngo5 sing4 go3 sing1 kei4 ngo5 fan3 gaau3 dou1 zung6 nam2 zyu6
